properties.statement: Wrote a Python script — three separate times in one session — that loads the committed export and the working-tree export, diffs their node-id sets and per-node property maps, and prints ADDED / REMOVED / PROPERTIES CHANGED, to check an export for cross-branch drift before committing it. Used it before every export commit today. compare_designs does exactly this with the committed file as base_path; the where-am-i skill even names it first. I reached for the script because I wanted node-id sets I could eyeball, and did not think to ask whether the served tool already returned them.
